findings.failure_path: The executed-evidence record claims the right-digest rejected-closeout case verifies that the closeout 'is listed as rejected'. The supplied test checks only rc=1 and the unbound-round message. Silently skipping that ledger would satisfy every assertion, so the claimed diagnostic behavior is not covered.
findings.smallest_fix: Remove the unsupported diagnostic claim, or assert that the output names the rejected closeout and rerun the suite before recording that result.

findings.failure_path: The change widens enumeration to the landing tree, including manifests, but the bounded packet omits scan, validator_accepts, and the complete manifest validation path. Consequently, it cannot establish that only committed evidence is consumed or that a later manifest cannot bind inappropriate coverage. The retrospective closeout and its validation artifacts are also absent; the plan's success statements cannot independently establish this required high-risk check.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply those unchanged boundary implementations and inspectable retrospective closeout validation evidence in the bounded review packet, including the exact candidate digest and binding result.

challenge_focus: Authorized succession on the landing candidate: (1) the plan executed-evidence wording, the tightened round scoping 16/17 assertions and the pinned bases of round scoping 18 — do they exercise and record what they claim; (2) any remaining way expandable_merge expands a sync or yields the collapsed span on a git failure; (3) any remaining way landing-tree evidence binds a round it should not.
predecessor_challenge_focuses: Adversarial: (1) any way a merge that git did not fully reproduce, or whose second parent is a sync of the base or of the line, gets expanded or gets a lenient span — including git failures whose exit status is swallowed; (2) any way expansion lets owner work sit in no round or lets a row cover work outside its round, versus the branch-head view CI evaluates; (3) any way reading chain evidence from the landing tree accepts a ledger that the round-checkout rule would have refused (forged, other digest, unvalidated, uncommitted), or changes the round packet, base or excludes.
